اعتطفتن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَطَفْتُنَّ (iʕtaṭaftunna) /iʕ.ta.tˤaf.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# اُعْتُطِفْتُنَّ (uʕtuṭiftunna) /uʕ.tu.tˤif.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
